summary.name: AI or Not
summary.one_liner: AI or Not is a web tool and API that checks whether images, text, videos, audio, or deepfakes were AI-generated.
keywords: check if text is written by ai
use_cases: Checking whether a photo or image is AI-generated
Screening submitted text for AI authorship
Verifying music tracks for AI generation
Adding AI-content detection to an app via API
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI detection service covering images, text, video, audio (MP3, MP4, PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF formats), and deepfakes. Users upload a file by drag-and-drop or file selection, and the tool shows an AI score and a deepfake score with a breakdown by generator such as Stable Diffusion or Midjourney. The service is also offered as an API. The page claims 98.9% accuracy, 7M+ checks run, and 500K+ users, and its meta description names ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Suno, Udio, Veo, and Kling as detection targets.
notable: Covers image, text, video, audio, and deepfake detection in one tool
Offers an API for programmatic AI-content detection
Per-generator breakdown, e.g. Stable Diffusion and Midjourney
caveats: Accuracy figure of 98.9% is a self-reported claim on the page, not independently verified
Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
